laws.rule: Liwonde National Park and Lake Malawi National Park: the published protected-area regulations exempt these two parks from the default requirement to enter in a motor vehicle with at least four wheels. This is not unrestricted water access: entering or remaining in their water areas requires written permission from the Chief Parks and Wildlife Officer or Wildlife Officer. Arrange an authorised boat or water activity rather than treating the land-entry exception as water permission.
